backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing trades, accounts, user profiles, and performance metrics with admin‑gated CRUD methods and authorization mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing static text update requirements for HomePage metrics along with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each frontend file’s purpose across routing, UI layout, pages, utility hooks, and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind setup defining theme CSS variables for light and dark modes and applying global background and border styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading the React app root and main script with the site title.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React entry configuring public and admin routes with TanStack Router, theme provider, and global site gate.
Admin layout with header, logout handling via Internet Identity, and wrapper for admin pages.
frontend/src/components/app/AppHeader.ts: Header showing link to homepage and wordmark image asset.
frontend/src/components/app/PublicFooter: Footer displaying trading risk disclaimer and copyright text.
frontend/src/components/app/PublicLayout: Public layout with header, navigation bar, textured background, main content area, and footer.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/A: Modal form for creating or editing managed accounts, handling input state, submission, and mutation calls.
Displays a table of accounts with edit and delete actions, plus a dialog for adding or updating accounts.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/C: Provides CSV upload, validation preview, and batch import of trades using admin mutations.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/M: Fetches and displays performance metrics in an editable form and updates them via admin mutation.
frontend/src/features/admin/components/T: Modal form for adding or editing trade records with field state handling and submission via mutations.
Renders a table for viewing, adding, editing, and deleting trades using admin actions and mutation hooks.
frontend/src/features/admin/hooks/useAdm: Provides React Query mutation hooks for CRUD operations on trades, accounts, and performance metrics.
frontend/src/features/admin/pages/AdminD: Admin dashboard with tabbed navigation for managing trades, accounts, metrics, and CSV import.
frontend/src/features/admin/utils/csv.ts: Parses a CSV file into validated trade objects and collects row-level validation errors.
frontend/src/features/analytics/componen: SVG-based equity curve chart that plots equity over trades with grid lines and labels.
Renders a scrollable bar chart showing monthly profit and loss values.
Displays a donut chart and legend summarizing win/loss counts and percentages.
frontend/src/features/analytics/pages/Pe: Loads trades and metrics and displays monthly P&L, win/loss distribution, and equity curve charts.
frontend/src/features/analytics/utils/an: Provides functions to compute monthly PnL, win/loss counts, and an equity curve from trade data.
frontend/src/features/auth/components/Ad: A gate component that verifies admin authentication and redirects or blocks access accordingly.
frontend/src/features/auth/hooks/useAdmi: Custom hook that checks Internet Identity login state and queries whether the user is an admin.
frontend/src/features/auth/pages/AdminLo: Login page for admin users using Internet Identity with redirect on successful admin authentication.
frontend/src/features/auth/types.ts: Defines types for authentication status and auth state structure.
frontend/src/features/data/queries.ts: React Query hooks to fetch performance metrics, trades, and managed accounts via actor calls.
frontend/src/features/public/components/: Displays a simple generated growth chart for an account balance using SVG graphics.
UI component with dropdowns for filtering trades by month, year, and result.
Renders a table of trades with formatting, icons, and profit/loss indicators.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/HomeP: Home dashboard page showing performance metrics and summary cards using fetched data.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/Manag: Displays managed accounts with masked names, balances, risk profiles, and growth charts, handling loading and empty states.
frontend/src/features/public/pages/Portf: Shows trade history with filters for month, year, and result, rendering a table or skeleton during loading.
frontend/src/features/public/utils/maski: Provides a helper to mask account names by revealing only the first two and last two characters.
frontend/src/features/seo/usePageMeta.ts: Sets document title and meta description when pages load.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/GateScree: Renders a login form for gated site access with error and loading handling.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/SiteWideG: Wraps content with a gate requiring valid credentials before rendering children.
frontend/src/features/siteGate/useSiteGa: Manages site gate authentication state using sessionStorage with simple username/password checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, invalidating related queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context and login management using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and color variables for light and dark themes including chart palettes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL and hash parameters, store/retrieve them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, existing metric‑update features, and a new in‑progress request for setting static homepage metric values.
